title: PPD shut down and possibly reborn as other programs

tellings.quote: I'm I'm pretty sure that PBD has been shut down.

plain: PPD, the secret programme in which he says he was trained to communicate with aliens, has been shut down and may live on under other names. Dan Sherman, a former Air Force sergeant who says the NSA, the US signals intelligence agency, hired him for that work in the early 1990s, says he is "pretty sure" it ended, and a man named Scott Andrews is part of the telling. It would mean the work carried on in other, hidden programmes.
